passages.label: Mart. 14.1.1
passages.text: Synthesibus dum gaudet eques dominusque senator

passages.label: Mart. 14.1.2
passages.text: Dumque decent nostrum pillea sumpta Iovem;

passages.label: Mart. 14.1.3
passages.text: Nec timet aedilem moto spectare fritillo,

passages.label: Mart. 14.1.4
passages.text: Cum videat gelidos tam prope verna lacus:

passages.label: Mart. 14.1.5
passages.text: Divitis alternas et pauperis accipe sortes:

passages.label: Mart. 14.1.6
passages.text: Praemia convivae dent sua quisque suo.

passages.label: Mart. 14.1.7
passages.text: 'Sunt apinae tricaeque et si quid vilius istis.'

passages.label: Mart. 14.1.8
passages.text: Quis nescit? vel quis tam manifesta negat?

passages.label: Mart. 14.1.9
passages.text: Sed quid agam potius madidis, Saturne, diebus,

passages.label: Mart. 14.1.10
passages.text: Quos tibi pro caelo filius ipse dedit?

passages.label: Mart. 14.1.11
passages.text: Vis scribam Thebas Troiamve malasve Mycenas?

passages.label: Mart. 14.1.12
passages.text: 'Lude,' inquis, 'nucibus'. Perdere nolo nuces.

passages.label: Mart. 14.2.1
passages.text: Quo vis cumque loco potes hunc finire libellum:

passages.label: Mart. 14.2.2
passages.text: Versibus explicitumst omne duobus opus.

passages.label: Mart. 14.2.3
passages.text: Lemmata si quaeris cur sint adscripta, docebo:

passages.label: Mart. 14.2.4
passages.text: Ut, si malueris, lemmata sola legas.

passages.label: Mart. 14.3.1
passages.text: Secta nisi in tenues essemus ligna tabellas,

passages.label: Mart. 14.3.2
passages.text: Essemus Libyci nobile dentis onus.

passages.label: Mart. 14.4.1
passages.text: Caede iuvencorum domini calet area felix,

passages.label: Mart. 14.4.2
passages.text: Quinquiplici cera cum datur altus honos.

passages.label: Mart. 14.5.1
passages.text: Languida ne tristes obscurent lumina cerae,

passages.label: Mart. 14.5.2
passages.text: Nigra tibi niveum littera pingat ebur.

passages.label: Mart. 14.6.1
passages.text: Tunc triplices nostros non vilia dona putabis,

passages.label: Mart. 14.6.2
passages.text: Cum se venturam scribet amica tibi.

passages.label: Mart. 14.7.1
passages.text: Esse puta ceras, licet haec membrana vocetur:

passages.label: Mart. 14.7.2
passages.text: Delebis, quotiens scripta novare voles.

passages.label: Mart. 14.8.1
passages.text: Nondum legerit hos licet puella,

passages.label: Mart. 14.8.2
passages.text: Novit quid cupiant Vitelliani.

passages.label: Mart. 14.9.1
passages.text: Quod minimos cernis, mitti nos credis amicae.

passages.label: Mart. 14.9.2
passages.text: Falleris: et nummos ista tabella rogat.

passages.label: Mart. 14.10.1
passages.text: Non est, munera quod putes pusilla,

passages.label: Mart. 14.10.2
passages.text: Cum donat vacuas poeta chartas.

passages.label: Mart. 14.11.1
passages.text: Seu leviter noto, seu caro missa sodali

passages.label: Mart. 14.11.2
passages.text: Omnes ista solet charta vocare suos.

passages.label: Mart. 14.12.1
passages.text: Hos nisi de flava loculos implere moneta

passages.label: Mart. 14.12.2
passages.text: Non decet: argentum vilia ligna ferant.

passages.label: Mart. 14.13.1
passages.text: Si quid adhuc superest in nostri faece locelli,

passages.label: Mart. 14.13.2
passages.text: Munus erit. Nihil est: ipse locellus erit.

passages.label: Mart. 14.14.1
passages.text: Cum steterit nullus vultu tibi talus eodem,

passages.label: Mart. 14.14.2
passages.text: Munera me dices magna dedisse tibi.

passages.label: Mart. 14.15.1
passages.text: Non sim talorum numero par tessera, dum sit

passages.label: Mart. 14.15.2
passages.text: Maior, quam talis, alea saepe mihi.

passages.label: Mart. 14.16.1
passages.text: Quae scit compositos manus improba mittere talos,

passages.label: Mart. 14.16.2
passages.text: Si per me misit, nil nisi vota feret.

passages.label: Mart. 14.17.1
passages.text: Hac mihi bis seno numeratur tessera puncto;

passages.label: Mart. 14.17.2
passages.text: Calculus hac gemino discolor hoste perit.

passages.label: Mart. 14.18.1
passages.text: Insidiosorum si ludis bella latronum,

passages.label: Mart. 14.18.2
passages.text: Gemmeus iste tibi miles et hostis erit.

passages.label: Mart. 14.19.1
passages.text: Alea parva nuces et non damnosa videtur;

passages.label: Mart. 14.19.2
passages.text: Saepe tamen pueris abstulit illa natis.

passages.label: Mart. 14.20.1
passages.text: Sortitus thecam calamis armare memento:

passages.label: Mart. 14.20.2
passages.text: Cetera nos dedimus, tu leviora para.

passages.label: Mart. 14.21.1
passages.text: Haec tibi erunt armata suo graphiaria ferro:

passages.label: Mart. 14.21.2
passages.text: Si puero dones, non leve munus erit.

passages.label: Mart. 14.22.1
passages.text: Lentiscum melius: sed si tibi frondea cuspis

passages.label: Mart. 14.22.2
passages.text: Defuerit, dentes pinna levare potest.

passages.label: Mart. 14.23.1
passages.text: Si tibi morosa prurigine verminat auris,

passages.label: Mart. 14.23.2
passages.text: Arma damus tantis apta libidinibus.

passages.label: Mart. 14.24.1
passages.text: Splendida ne madidi violent bombycina crines,

passages.label: Mart. 14.24.2
passages.text: Figat acus tortas sustineatque comas.

passages.label: Mart. 14.25.1
passages.text: Quid faciet nullos hic inventura capillos

passages.label: Mart. 14.25.2
passages.text: Multifido buxus quae tibi dente datur?

passages.label: Mart. 14.26.1
passages.text: Chattica Teutonicos accendit spuma capillos:

passages.label: Mart. 14.26.2
passages.text: Captivis poteris cultior esse comis.

passages.label: Mart. 14.27.1
passages.text: Si mutare paras longaevos cana capillos,

passages.label: Mart. 14.27.2
passages.text: Accipe Mattiacas—quo tibi calva?—pilas.

passages.label: Mart. 14.28.1
passages.text: Accipe quae nimios vincant umbracula soles:

passages.label: Mart. 14.28.2
passages.text: Sit licet et ventus, te tua vela tegent.

passages.label: Mart. 14.29.1
passages.text: In Pompeiano tecum spectabo theatro:

passages.label: Mart. 14.29.2
passages.text: Mandatus populo vela negare solet.

passages.label: Mart. 14.30.1
passages.text: Excipient apros expectabuntque leones,

passages.label: Mart. 14.30.2
passages.text: Intrabunt ursos, sit modo firma manus.

passages.label: Mart. 14.31.1
passages.text: Si deiecta gemas longo venabula rostro,

passages.label: Mart. 14.31.2
passages.text: Hic brevis ingentem comminus ibit aprum.

passages.label: Mart. 14.32.1
passages.text: Militiae decus hoc gratique erit omen honoris,

passages.label: Mart. 14.32.2
passages.text: Arma tribunicium cingere digna latus.

passages.label: Mart. 14.33.1
passages.text: Pugio, quem curva signat brevis orbita vena.

passages.label: Mart. 14.33.2
passages.text: Stridentem gelidis hunc Salo tinxit aquis.

passages.label: Mart. 14.34.1
passages.text: Pax me certa ducis placidos curvavit in usus.

passages.label: Mart. 14.34.2
passages.text: Agricolae nunc sum, militis ante fui.

passages.label: Mart. 14.35.1
passages.text: Cum fieret tristis solvendis auctio nummis,

passages.label: Mart. 14.35.2
passages.text: Haec quadringentis milibus empta fuit.

passages.label: Mart. 14.36.1
passages.text: Tondendis haec arma tibi sunt apta capillis;

passages.label: Mart. 14.36.2
passages.text: Unguibus hic longis utilis, illa genis.

passages.label: Mart. 14.37.1
passages.text: Selectos nisi das mihi libellos,

passages.label: Mart. 14.37.2
passages.text: Admittam tineas trucesque blattas.

passages.label: Mart. 14.38.1
passages.text: Dat chartis habiles calamos Memphitica tellus;

passages.label: Mart. 14.38.2
passages.text: Texantur reliqua tecta palude tibi.

passages.label: Mart. 14.39.1
passages.text: Dulcis conscia lectuli lucerna,

passages.label: Mart. 14.39.2
passages.text: Quidquid vis facias licet, tacebo.

passages.label: Mart. 14.40.1
passages.text: Ancillam tibi sors dedit lucernae,

passages.label: Mart. 14.40.2
passages.text: Totas quae vigil exigit tenebras.

passages.label: Mart. 14.41.1
passages.text: Inlustrem cum tota meis convivia flammis

passages.label: Mart. 14.41.2
passages.text: Totque geram myxos, una lucerna vocor.

passages.label: Mart. 14.42.1
passages.text: Hic tibi nocturnos praestabit cereus ignes:

passages.label: Mart. 14.42.2
passages.text: Subducta est puero namque lucerna tuo.

passages.label: Mart. 14.43.1
passages.text: Nomina candelae nobis antiqua dederunt:

passages.label: Mart. 14.43.2
passages.text: Non norat parcos uncta lucerna patres.

passages.label: Mart. 14.44.1
passages.text: Esse vides lignum; servas nisi lumina, fiet

passages.label: Mart. 14.44.2
passages.text: De candelabro magna lucerna tibi.

passages.label: Mart. 14.45.1
passages.text: Haec quae difficili turget paganica pluma,

passages.label: Mart. 14.45.2
passages.text: Folle minus laxast et minus arta pila.

passages.label: Mart. 14.46.1
passages.text: Si me nobilibus scis expulsare sinistris,

passages.label: Mart. 14.46.2
passages.text: Sum tua. Tu nescis? rustice, redde pilam.

passages.label: Mart. 14.47.1
passages.text: Ite procul, iuvenes: mitis mihi convenit aetas:

passages.label: Mart. 14.47.2
passages.text: Folle decet pueros ludere, folle senes.

passages.label: Mart. 14.48.1
passages.text: Haec rapit Antaei velox in pulvere draucus,

passages.label: Mart. 14.48.2
passages.text: Grandia qui vano colla labore facit.

passages.label: Mart. 14.49.1
passages.text: Quid pereunt stulto fortes haltere lacerti?

passages.label: Mart. 14.49.2
passages.text: Exercet melius vinea fossa viros.

passages.label: Mart. 14.50.1
passages.text: Ne lutet inmundum nitidos ceroma capillos,

passages.label: Mart. 14.50.2
passages.text: Hac poteris madidas condere pelle comas.

passages.label: Mart. 14.51.1
passages.text: Pergamon has misit. Curvo destringere ferro:

passages.label: Mart. 14.51.2
passages.text: Non tam saepe teret lintea fullo tibi.

passages.label: Mart. 14.52.1
passages.text: Gestavit modo fronte me iuvencus:

passages.label: Mart. 14.52.2
passages.text: Verum rhinocerota me putabas.

passages.label: Mart. 14.53.1
passages.text: Nuper in Ausonia domini spectatus harena

passages.label: Mart. 14.53.2
passages.text: Hic erit ille tibi, cui pila taurus erat.

passages.label: Mart. 14.54.1
passages.text: Si quis plorator collo tibi vernula pendet,

passages.label: Mart. 14.54.2
passages.text: Haec quatiat tenera garrula sistra manu.

passages.label: Mart. 14.55.1
passages.text: Proficies nihil hoc, caedas licet usque, flagello,

passages.label: Mart. 14.55.2
passages.text: Si tibi purpureo de grege currit equus.

passages.label: Mart. 14.56.1
passages.text: Quid mecum est tibi? me puella sumat:

passages.label: Mart. 14.56.2
passages.text: Emptos non soleo polire dentes.

passages.label: Mart. 14.57.1
passages.text: Quod nec Vergilius nec carmine dicit Homerus,

passages.label: Mart. 14.57.2
passages.text: Hoc ex unguento constat et ex balano.

passages.label: Mart. 14.58.1
passages.text: Rusticus es? nescis, quid Graeco nomine dicar:

passages.label: Mart. 14.58.2
passages.text: Spuma vocor nitri. Graecus es? aphronitrum.

passages.label: Mart. 14.59.1
passages.text: Balsama me capiunt, haec sunt unguenta virorum:

passages.label: Mart. 14.59.2
passages.text: Delicias Cosmi vos redolete, nurus.

passages.label: Mart. 14.60.1
passages.text: Gratum munus erit scisso nec inutile ventri,

passages.label: Mart. 14.60.2
passages.text: Si clara Stephani balnea luce petes.

passages.label: Mart. 14.61.1
passages.text: Dux lanterna viae clusis feror aurea flammis,

passages.label: Mart. 14.61.2
passages.text: Et tuta est gremio parva lucerna meo.

passages.label: Mart. 14.62.1
passages.text: Cornea si non sum, numquid sum fuscior? aut me

passages.label: Mart. 14.62.2
passages.text: Vesicam, contra qui venit, esse putat?

passages.label: Mart. 14.63.1
passages.text: Ebria nos madidis rumpit tibicina buccis:

passages.label: Mart. 14.63.2
passages.text: Saepe duas pariter, saepe monaulon habet.

passages.label: Mart. 14.64.1
passages.text: Quid me conpactam ceris et harundine rides?

passages.label: Mart. 14.64.2
passages.text: Quae primum structa est fistula talis erat.

passages.label: Mart. 14.65.1
passages.text: Defuerit si forte puer soleasque libebit

passages.label: Mart. 14.65.2
passages.text: Sumere, pro puero pes erit ipse sibi.

passages.label: Mart. 14.66.1
passages.text: Taurino poteras pectus constringere tergo:

passages.label: Mart. 14.66.2
passages.text: Nam pellis mammas non capit ista tuas.

passages.label: Mart. 14.67.1
passages.text: Lambere quae turpes prohibet tua prandia muscas,

passages.label: Mart. 14.67.2
passages.text: Alitis eximiae cauda superba fuit.

passages.label: Mart. 14.68.1
passages.text: Sordida si flavo fuerit tibi pulvere vestis,

passages.label: Mart. 14.68.2
passages.text: Colligat hunc tenui verbere cauda levis.

passages.label: Mart. 14.69.1
passages.text: Peccantis famuli pugno ne percute dentes:

passages.label: Mart. 14.69.2
passages.text: Clara Rhodos coptam quam tibi misit edat.

passages.label: Mart. 14.70.1
passages.text: Si vis esse satur, nostrum potes esse Priapum:

passages.label: Mart. 14.70.2
passages.text: Ipsa licet rodas inguina, purus eris.

passages.label: Mart. 14.71.1
passages.text: Iste tibi faciet bona Saturnalia porcus,

passages.label: Mart. 14.71.2
passages.text: Inter spumantes ilice pastus apros.

passages.label: Mart. 14.72.1
passages.text: Qui venit botulus mediae tibi tempore brumae,

passages.label: Mart. 14.72.2
passages.text: Saturni septem venerat ante dies.

passages.label: Mart. 14.73.1
passages.text: Psittacus a vobis aliorum nomina discam:

passages.label: Mart. 14.73.2
passages.text: Hoc didici per me dicere caesar have.

passages.label: Mart. 14.74.1
passages.text: Corve salutator, quare fellator haberis?

passages.label: Mart. 14.74.2
passages.text: In caput intravit mentula nulla tuum.

passages.label: Mart. 14.75.1
passages.text: Flet Philomela nefas incesti Tereos, et quae

passages.label: Mart. 14.75.2
passages.text: Muta puella fuit, garrula fertur avis.

passages.label: Mart. 14.76.1
passages.text: Pica loquax certa dominum te voce saluto:

passages.label: Mart. 14.76.2
passages.text: Si me non videas, esse negabis avem.

passages.label: Mart. 14.77.1
passages.text: Si tibi talis erit, qualem dilecta Catullo

passages.label: Mart. 14.77.2
passages.text: Lesbia plorabat, hic habitare potest.

passages.label: Mart. 14.78.1
passages.text: Artis ebur medicae narthecia cernis: habebis

passages.label: Mart. 14.78.2
passages.text: Munera, quae cuperet Paccius esse sua.

passages.label: Mart. 14.79.1
passages.text: Ludite lascivi, sed tantum ludite, servi:

passages.label: Mart. 14.79.2
passages.text: Haec signata mihi quinque diebus erunt.

passages.label: Mart. 14.80.1
passages.text: Invisae nimium pueris grataeque magistris,

passages.label: Mart. 14.80.2
passages.text: Clara Prometheo munere ligna sumus.

passages.label: Mart. 14.81.1
passages.text: Ne mendica ferat barbati prandia nudi

passages.label: Mart. 14.81.2
passages.text: Dormiat et tetrico cum cane, pera rogat.

passages.label: Mart. 14.82.1
passages.text: In pretio scopas testatur palma fuisse.

passages.label: Mart. 14.82.2
passages.text: Otia sed scopis nunc analecta dedit.

passages.label: Mart. 14.83.1
passages.text: Defendet manus haec scapulas mordente molesto

passages.label: Mart. 14.83.2
passages.text: Pulice, vel si quid pulice sordidius.

passages.label: Mart. 14.84.1
passages.text: Ne toga barbatos faciat vel paenula libros,

passages.label: Mart. 14.84.2
passages.text: Haec abies chartis tempora longa dabit.

passages.label: Mart. 14.85.1
passages.text: Nomina dat spondae pictis pulcherrima pinnis

passages.label: Mart. 14.85.2
passages.text: Nunc Iunonis avis, sed prius Argus erat.

passages.label: Mart. 14.86.1
passages.text: Stragula succincti venator sume veredi:

passages.label: Mart. 14.86.2
passages.text: Nam solet a nudo surgere ficus equo.

passages.label: Mart. 14.87.1
passages.text: Accipe lunata scriptum testudine sigma.

passages.label: Mart. 14.87.2
passages.text: Octo capit; veniat quisquis amicus erit.

passages.label: Mart. 14.88.1
passages.text: Femineam nobis cherson si credis inesse,

passages.label: Mart. 14.88.2
passages.text: Deciperis: pelagi mascula praeda sumus.

passages.label: Mart. 14.89.1
passages.text: Accipe felices, Atlantica munera, silvas:

passages.label: Mart. 14.89.2
passages.text: Aurea qui dederit dona, minora dabit.

passages.label: Mart. 14.90.1
passages.text: Non sum crispa quidem nec silvae filia Maurae,

passages.label: Mart. 14.90.2
passages.text: Sed norunt lautas et mea ligna dapes.

passages.label: Mart. 14.91.1
passages.text: Grandia taurorum portant qui corpora, quaeris,

passages.label: Mart. 14.91.2
passages.text: An Libycas possint sustinuisse trabes?

passages.label: Mart. 14.92.1
passages.text: Puncta notis ilex et acuta cuspide clusa

passages.label: Mart. 14.92.2
passages.text: Saepe redemptoris prodere furta solet.

passages.label: Mart. 14.93.1
passages.text: Non est ista recens nec nostri gloria caeli:

passages.label: Mart. 14.93.2
passages.text: Primus in his Mentor, dum facit illa, bibit.

passages.label: Mart. 14.94.1
passages.text: Nos sumus audacis plebeia toreumata vitri,

passages.label: Mart. 14.94.2
passages.text: Nostra neque ardenti gemma feritur aqua.

passages.label: Mart. 14.95.1
passages.text: Quamvis Callai+co rubeam generosa metallo,

passages.label: Mart. 14.95.2
passages.text: Glorior arte magis: nam Myos iste labor.

passages.label: Mart. 14.96.1
passages.text: Vilia sutoris calicem monimenta Vatini

passages.label: Mart. 14.96.2
passages.text: Accipe; sed nasus longior ille fuit.

passages.label: Mart. 14.97.1
passages.text: Grandia ne viola parvo chrysendeta mullo:

passages.label: Mart. 14.97.2
passages.text: Ut minimum, libras debet habere duas.

passages.label: Mart. 14.98.1
passages.text: Arretina nimis ne spernas vasa monemus:

passages.label: Mart. 14.98.2
passages.text: Lautus erat Tuscis Porsena fictilibus.

passages.label: Mart. 14.99.1
passages.text: Barbara de pictis veni bascauda Britannis;

passages.label: Mart. 14.99.2
passages.text: Sed me iam mavolt dicere Roma suam.

passages.label: Mart. 14.100.1
passages.text: Si non ignotast docti tibi terra Catulli,

passages.label: Mart. 14.100.2
passages.text: Potasti testa Raetica vina mea.

passages.label: Mart. 14.101.1
passages.text: Cum mihi boleti dederint tam nobile nomen,

passages.label: Mart. 14.101.2
passages.text: Prototomis—pudet heu!—servio coliculis.

passages.label: Mart. 14.102.1
passages.text: Accipe non vili calices de pulvere natos,

passages.label: Mart. 14.102.2
passages.text: Sed Surrentinae leve toreuma rotae.

passages.label: Mart. 14.103.1
passages.text: Setinos, moneo, nostra nive frange trientes:

passages.label: Mart. 14.103.2
passages.text: Pauperiore mero tingere lina potes.

passages.label: Mart. 14.104.1
passages.text: Attenuare nives norunt et lintea nostra:

passages.label: Mart. 14.104.2
passages.text: Frigidior colo non salit unda tuo.

passages.label: Mart. 14.105.1
passages.text: Frigida non deerit, non deerit calda petenti.

passages.label: Mart. 14.105.2
passages.text: Sed tu morosa ludere parce siti.

passages.label: Mart. 14.106.1
passages.text: Hic tibi donatur pansa ruber urceus ansa.

passages.label: Mart. 14.106.2
passages.text: Stoicus hoc gelidam Fronto petebat aquam.

passages.label: Mart. 14.107.1
passages.text: Nos Satyri, nos Bacchus amat, nos ebria tigris,

passages.label: Mart. 14.107.2
passages.text: Perfusos domini lambere docta pedes.

passages.label: Mart. 14.108.1
passages.text: Quae non sollicitus teneat servetque minister,

passages.label: Mart. 14.108.2
passages.text: Sume Saguntino pocula facta luto.

passages.label: Mart. 14.109.1
passages.text: Gemmatum Scythicis ut luceat ignibus aurum,

passages.label: Mart. 14.109.2
passages.text: Aspice. Quot digitos exuit iste calix!

passages.label: Mart. 14.110.1
passages.text: Hac licet in gemma, servat quae nomina Cosmi,

passages.label: Mart. 14.110.2
passages.text: Luxuriose, bibas, si foliata sitis.

passages.label: Mart. 14.111.1
passages.text: Frangere dum metuis, franges crystallina: peccant

passages.label: Mart. 14.111.2
passages.text: Securae nimium sollicitaeque manus.

passages.label: Mart. 14.112.1
passages.text: A Iove qui veniet, miscenda ad pocula largas

passages.label: Mart. 14.112.2
passages.text: Fundet nimbus aquas: hic tibi vina dabit.

passages.label: Mart. 14.113.1
passages.text: Si caldum potas, ardenti murra Falerno

passages.label: Mart. 14.113.2
passages.text: Convenit et melior fit sapor inde mero.

passages.label: Mart. 14.114.1
passages.text: Hanc tibi Cumano rubicundam pulvere testam

passages.label: Mart. 14.114.2
passages.text: Municipem misit casta Sibylla suam.

passages.label: Mart. 14.115.1
passages.text: Aspicis ingenium Nili: quibus addere plura

passages.label: Mart. 14.115.2
passages.text: Dum cupit, a quotiens perdidit auctor opus!

passages.label: Mart. 14.116.1
passages.text: Spoletina bibis vel Marsis condita cellis:

passages.label: Mart. 14.116.2
passages.text: Quo tibi decoctae nobile frigus aquae?

passages.label: Mart. 14.117.1
passages.text: Non potare nivem, sed aquam potare recentem

passages.label: Mart. 14.117.2
passages.text: De nive commenta est ingeniosa sitis.

passages.label: Mart. 14.118.1
passages.text: Massiliae fumos miscere nivalibus undis

passages.label: Mart. 14.118.2
passages.text: Parce, puer, constet ne tibi pluris aqua.

passages.label: Mart. 14.119.1
passages.text: Dum poscor crepitu digitorum et verna moratur,

passages.label: Mart. 14.119.2
passages.text: O quotiens paelex culcita facta mea est!

passages.label: Mart. 14.120.1
passages.text: Quamvis me ligulam dicant equitesque patresque,

passages.label: Mart. 14.120.2
passages.text: Dicor ab indoctis lingula grammaticis.

passages.label: Mart. 14.121.1
passages.text: Sum cocleis habilis, sed nec minus utilis ovis.

passages.label: Mart. 14.121.2
passages.text: Numquid scis, potius cur cocleare vocer?

passages.label: Mart. 14.122.1
passages.text: Ante frequens, sed nunc rarus nos donat amicus.

passages.label: Mart. 14.122.2
passages.text: Felix, cui comes est non alienus eques.

passages.label: Mart. 14.123.1
passages.text: Saepe gravis digitis elabitur anulus unctis,

passages.label: Mart. 14.123.2
passages.text: Tuta mea fiet sed tua gemma fide.

passages.label: Mart. 14.124.1
passages.text: Romanos rerum dominos gentemque togatam

passages.label: Mart. 14.124.2
passages.text: Ille facit, magno qui dedit astra patri.

passages.label: Mart. 14.125.1
passages.text: Si matutinos facilest tibi perdere somnos,

passages.label: Mart. 14.125.2
passages.text: Attrita veniet sportula saepe toga.

passages.label: Mart. 14.126.1
passages.text: Pauperis est munus, sed non est pauperis usus:

passages.label: Mart. 14.126.2
passages.text: Hanc tibi pro laena mittimus endromida.

passages.label: Mart. 14.127.1
passages.text: Haec tibi turbato Canusina simillima mulso

passages.label: Mart. 14.127.2
passages.text: Munus erit. Gaude: non cito fiet anus.

passages.label: Mart. 14.128.1
passages.text: Gallia Santonico vestit te bardocucullo.

passages.label: Mart. 14.128.2
passages.text: Cercopithecorum paenula nuper erat.

passages.label: Mart. 14.129.1
passages.text: Roma magis fuscis vestitur, Gallia rufis,

passages.label: Mart. 14.129.2
passages.text: Et placet hic pueris militibusque colos.

passages.label: Mart. 14.130.1
passages.text: Ingrediare viam caelo licet usque sereno,

passages.label: Mart. 14.130.2
passages.text: Ad subitas numquam scortea desit aquas.

passages.label: Mart. 14.131.1
passages.text: Si veneto prasinove faves, quid coccina sumes?

passages.label: Mart. 14.131.2
passages.text: Ne fias ista transfuga sorte, vide.

passages.label: Mart. 14.132.1
passages.text: Si possem, totas cuperem misisse lacernas:

passages.label: Mart. 14.132.2
passages.text: Nunc tantum capiti munera mitto tuo.

passages.label: Mart. 14.133.1
passages.text: Non est lana mihi mendax, nec mutor aheno.

passages.label: Mart. 14.133.2
passages.text: Sic placeant Tyriae: me mea tinxit ovis.

passages.label: Mart. 14.134.1
passages.text: Fascia, crescentes dominae compesce papillas,

passages.label: Mart. 14.134.2
passages.text: Ut sit quod capiat nostra tegatque manus.

passages.label: Mart. 14.135.1
passages.text: Amphitheatrali nos commendamus ab usu,

passages.label: Mart. 14.135.2
passages.text: Cum teget algentes alba lacerna togas.

passages.label: Mart. 14.136.1
passages.text: Nec fora sunt nobis nec sunt vadimonia nota:

passages.label: Mart. 14.136.2
passages.text: Hoc opus est, pictis accubuisse toris.

passages.label: Mart. 14.137.1
passages.text: Si recitaturus dedero tibi forte libellum,

passages.label: Mart. 14.137.2
passages.text: Hoc focale tuas adserat auriculas.

passages.label: Mart. 14.138.1
passages.text: Tempore brumali non multum levia prosunt:

passages.label: Mart. 14.138.2
passages.text: Calfaciunt villi pallia vestra mei.

passages.label: Mart. 14.139.1
passages.text: Nobilius villosa tegant tibi lintea citrum:

passages.label: Mart. 14.139.2
passages.text: Orbibus in nostris circulus esse potest.

passages.label: Mart. 14.140.1
passages.text: Iungere nescisti nobis, o stulte, lacernas:

passages.label: Mart. 14.140.2
passages.text: Indueras albas, exue callai+nas.

passages.label: Mart. 14.141.1
passages.text: Non hos lana dedit, sed olentis barba mariti:

passages.label: Mart. 14.141.2
passages.text: Cinyphio poterit planta latere sinu.

passages.label: Mart. 14.142.1
passages.text: Dum toga per quinas gaudet requiescere luces,

passages.label: Mart. 14.142.2
passages.text: Hos poteris cultus sumere iure tuo.

passages.label: Mart. 14.143.1
passages.text: Vellera consumunt Patavinae multa trilices,

passages.label: Mart. 14.143.2
passages.text: Et pingues tunicas serra secare potest.

passages.label: Mart. 14.144.1
passages.text: Haec tibi sorte datur tergendis spongia mensis

passages.label: Mart. 14.144.2
passages.text: Utilis, expresso cum levis imbre tumet.

passages.label: Mart. 14.145.1
passages.text: Is mihi candor inest, villorum gratia tanta,

passages.label: Mart. 14.145.2
passages.text: Ut me vel media sumere messe velis.

passages.label: Mart. 14.146.1
passages.text: Tingue caput Cosmi folio, cervical olebit:

passages.label: Mart. 14.146.2
passages.text: Perdidit unguentum cum coma, pluma tenet.

passages.label: Mart. 14.147.1
passages.text: Stragula purpureis lucent villosa tapetis.

passages.label: Mart. 14.147.2
passages.text: Quid prodest, si te congelat uxor anus?

passages.label: Mart. 14.148.1
passages.text: Nudo stragula ne toro paterent,

passages.label: Mart. 14.148.2
passages.text: Iunctae nos tibi venimus sorores.

passages.label: Mart. 14.149.1
passages.text: Mammosas metuo; tenerae me trade puellae,

passages.label: Mart. 14.149.2
passages.text: Ut possint niveo pectore lina frui.

passages.label: Mart. 14.150.1
passages.text: Haec tibi Memphitis tellus dat munera: victa est

passages.label: Mart. 14.150.2
passages.text: Pectine Niliaco iam Babylonos acus.

passages.label: Mart. 14.151.1
passages.text: Longa satis nunc sum; dulci sed pondere venter

passages.label: Mart. 14.151.2
passages.text: Si tumeat, fiam tunc tibi zona brevis.

passages.label: Mart. 14.152.1
passages.text: Lodices mittet docti tibi terra Catulli:

passages.label: Mart. 14.152.2
passages.text: Nos Helicaonia de regione sumus.

passages.label: Mart. 14.153.1
passages.text: Det tunicam locuples: ego te praecingere possum.

passages.label: Mart. 14.153.2
passages.text: Essem si locuples, munus utrumque darem.

passages.label: Mart. 14.154.1
passages.text: Ebria Sidoniae cum sim de sanguine conchae,

passages.label: Mart. 14.154.2
passages.text: Non video, quare sobria lana vocer.

passages.label: Mart. 14.155.1
passages.text: Velleribus primis Apulia, Parma secundis

passages.label: Mart. 14.155.2
passages.text: Nobilis; Altinum tertia laudat ovis.

passages.label: Mart. 14.156.1
passages.text: Nos Lacedaemoniae pastor donavit amicae:

passages.label: Mart. 14.156.2
passages.text: Deterior Ledae purpura matris erat.

passages.label: Mart. 14.157.1
passages.text: Non tantum pullo lugentes vellere lanas,

passages.label: Mart. 14.157.2
passages.text: Sed solet et calices haec dare terra suos.

passages.label: Mart. 14.158.1
passages.text: Lana quidem tristis, sed tonsis nata ministris,

passages.label: Mart. 14.158.2
passages.text: Quales non primo de grege mensa citat.

passages.label: Mart. 14.159.1
passages.text: Oppressae nimium vicina est fascia plumae?

passages.label: Mart. 14.159.2
passages.text: Vellera Leuconicis accipe rasa sagis.

passages.label: Mart. 14.160.1
passages.text: Tomentum concisa palus Circense vocatur.

passages.label: Mart. 14.160.2
passages.text: Haec pro Leuconico stramina pauper emit.

passages.label: Mart. 14.161.1
passages.text: Lassus Amyclaea poteris requiescere pluma,

passages.label: Mart. 14.161.2
passages.text: Interior cycni quam tibi lana dedit.

passages.label: Mart. 14.162.1
passages.text: Fraudata tumeat fragilis tibi culcita mula.

passages.label: Mart. 14.162.2
passages.text: Non venit ad duros pallida cura toros.

passages.label: Mart. 14.163.1
passages.text: Redde pilam: sonat aes thermarum. Ludere pergis?

passages.label: Mart. 14.163.2
passages.text: Virgine vis sola lotus abire domum.

passages.label: Mart. 14.164.1
passages.text: Splendida cum volitant Spartani pondera disci,

passages.label: Mart. 14.164.2
passages.text: Este procul, pueri: sit semel ille nocens.

passages.label: Mart. 14.165.1
passages.text: Reddidit Eurydicen vati: sed perdidit ipse,

passages.label: Mart. 14.165.2
passages.text: Dum sibi non credit nec patienter amat.

passages.label: Mart. 14.166.1
passages.text: De Pompeiano saepe est eiecta theatro

passages.label: Mart. 14.166.2
passages.text: Quae duxit silvas detinuitque feras.

passages.label: Mart. 14.167.1
passages.text: Fervida ne trito tibi pollice pusula surgat,

passages.label: Mart. 14.167.2
passages.text: Exornent docilem candida plectra lyram.

passages.label: Mart. 14.168.1
passages.text: Inducenda rota est: das nobis utile munus:

passages.label: Mart. 14.168.2
passages.text: Iste trochus pueris, at mihi cantus erit.

passages.label: Mart. 14.169.1
passages.text: Garrulus in laxo cur anulus orbe vagatur?

passages.label: Mart. 14.169.2
passages.text: Cedat ut argutis obvia turba trochis.

passages.label: Mart. 14.170.1
passages.text: Haec illi sine sorte datur, cui nomina Rhenus

passages.label: Mart. 14.170.2
passages.text: Vera dedit. Deciens adde Falerna, puer.

passages.label: Mart. 14.171.1
passages.text: Gloria tam parvi non est obscura sigilli:

passages.label: Mart. 14.171.2
passages.text: Istius pueri Brutus amator erat.

passages.label: Mart. 14.172.1
passages.text: Ad te reptanti, puer insidiose, lacertae

passages.label: Mart. 14.172.2
passages.text: Parce: cupit digitis illa perire tuis.

passages.label: Mart. 14.173.1
passages.text: Flectit ab inviso morientia lumina disco

passages.label: Mart. 14.173.2
passages.text: Oebalius, Phoebi culpa dolorque, puer.

passages.label: Mart. 14.174.1
passages.text: Masculus intravit fontis, emersit utrumque:

passages.label: Mart. 14.174.2
passages.text: Pars est una patris, cetera matris habet.

passages.label: Mart. 14.175.1
passages.text: Cur a te pretium Danae, regnator Olympi,

passages.label: Mart. 14.175.2
passages.text: Accepit, gratis si tibi Leda dedit?

passages.label: Mart. 14.176.1
passages.text: Sum figuli lusus russi persona Batavi.

passages.label: Mart. 14.176.2
passages.text: Quae tu derides, haec timet ora puer.

passages.label: Mart. 14.177.1
passages.text: Elidit geminos infans nec respicit anguis.

passages.label: Mart. 14.177.2
passages.text: Iam poterat teneras hydra timere manus.

passages.label: Mart. 14.178.1
passages.text: Sum fragilis: sed tu, moneo, ne sperne sigillum:

passages.label: Mart. 14.178.2
passages.text: Non pudet Alciden nomen habere meum.

passages.label: Mart. 14.179.1
passages.text: Dic mihi, virgo ferox, cum sit tibi cassis et hasta,

passages.label: Mart. 14.179.2
passages.text: Quare non habeas aegida. 'Caesar habet.'

passages.label: Mart. 14.180.1
passages.text: Mutari melius tauro, pater optime divum,

passages.label: Mart. 14.180.2
passages.text: Tunc poteras, Io cum tibi vacca fuit.

passages.label: Mart. 14.181.1
passages.text: Clamabat tumidis audax Leandros in undis:

passages.label: Mart. 14.181.2
passages.text: 'Mergite me, fluctus, cum rediturus ero.'

passages.label: Mart. 14.182.1
passages.text: Ebrius haec fecit terris, puto, monstra Prometheus:

passages.label: Mart. 14.182.2
passages.text: Saturnalicio lusit et ipse luto.

passages.label: Mart. 14.183.1
passages.text: Perlege Maeonio cantatas carmine ranas

passages.label: Mart. 14.183.2
passages.text: Et frontem nugis solvere disce meis.

passages.label: Mart. 14.184.1
passages.text: Ilias et Priami regnis inimicus Ulixes

passages.label: Mart. 14.184.2
passages.text: Multiplici pariter condita pelle latent.

passages.label: Mart. 14.185.1
passages.text: Accipe facundi Culicem, studiose, Maronis,

passages.label: Mart. 14.185.2
passages.text: Ne nucibus positis arma virumque legas.

passages.label: Mart. 14.186.1
passages.text: Quam brevis inmensum cepit membrana Maronem!

passages.label: Mart. 14.186.2
passages.text: Ipsius vultus prima tabella gerit.

passages.label: Mart. 14.187.1
passages.text: Hac primum iuvenum lascivos lusit amores;

passages.label: Mart. 14.187.2
passages.text: Nec Glycera pueri, Thais amica fuit.

passages.label: Mart. 14.188.1
passages.text: Si comes ista tibi fuerit membrana, putato

passages.label: Mart. 14.188.2
passages.text: Carpere te longas cum Cicerone vias.

passages.label: Mart. 14.189.1
passages.text: Cynthia—facundi carmen iuvenale Properti—

passages.label: Mart. 14.189.2
passages.text: Accepit famam, non minus ipsa dedit.

passages.label: Mart. 14.190.1
passages.text: Pellibus exiguis artatur Livius ingens,

passages.label: Mart. 14.190.2
passages.text: Quem mea non totum bibliotheca capit.

passages.label: Mart. 14.191.1
passages.text: Hic erit, ut perhibent doctorum corda virorum,

passages.label: Mart. 14.191.2
passages.text: Primus Romana Crispus in historia.

passages.label: Mart. 14.192.1
passages.text: Haec tibi, multiplici quae structa est massa tabella,

passages.label: Mart. 14.192.2
passages.text: Carmina Nasonis quinque decemque gerit.

passages.label: Mart. 14.193.1
passages.text: Ussit amatorem Nemesis lasciva Tibullum,

passages.label: Mart. 14.193.2
passages.text: In tota iuvit quem nihil esse domo.

passages.label: Mart. 14.194.1
passages.text: Sunt quidam, qui me dicant non esse poetam:

passages.label: Mart. 14.194.2
passages.text: Sed qui me vendit bybliopola putat.

passages.label: Mart. 14.195.1
passages.text: Tantum magna suo debet Verona Catullo,

passages.label: Mart. 14.195.2
passages.text: Quantum parva suo Mantua Vergilio.

passages.label: Mart. 14.196.1
passages.text: Haec tibi quae fontes et aquarum nomina dicit,

passages.label: Mart. 14.196.2
passages.text: Ipsa suas melius charta natabat aquas.

passages.label: Mart. 14.197.1
passages.text: His tibi de mulis non est metuenda ruina:

passages.label: Mart. 14.197.2
passages.text: Altius in terra paene sedere soles.

passages.label: Mart. 14.198.1
passages.text: Delicias parvae si vis audire catellae,

passages.label: Mart. 14.198.2
passages.text: Narranti brevis est pagina tota mihi.

passages.label: Mart. 14.199.1
passages.text: Hic brevis ad numeros rapidum qui colligit unguem,

passages.label: Mart. 14.199.2
passages.text: Venit ab auriferis gentibus Astur equus.

passages.label: Mart. 14.200.1
passages.text: Non sibi, sed domino venatur vertragus acer,

passages.label: Mart. 14.200.2
passages.text: Inlaesum leporem qui tibi dente feret.

passages.label: Mart. 14.201.1
passages.text: Non amo quod vincat, sed quod succumbere novit

passages.label: Mart. 14.201.2
passages.text: Et didicit melius τὴν ἐπικλινοπάλην.

passages.label: Mart. 14.202.1
passages.text: Callidus emissas eludere simius hastas,

passages.label: Mart. 14.202.2
passages.text: Si mihi cauda foret, cercopithecus eram.

passages.label: Mart. 14.203.1
passages.text: Tam tremulum crisat, tam blandum prurit, ut ipsum

passages.label: Mart. 14.203.2
passages.text: Masturbatorem fecerit Hippolytum.

passages.label: Mart. 14.204.1
passages.text: Aera Celaenaeos lugentia matris amores

passages.label: Mart. 14.204.2
passages.text: Esuriens Gallus vendere saepe solet.

passages.label: Mart. 14.205.1
passages.text: Sit nobis aetate puer, non pumice levis,

passages.label: Mart. 14.205.2
passages.text: Propter quem placeat nulla puella mihi.

passages.label: Mart. 14.206.1
passages.text: Collo necte, puer, meros amores,

passages.label: Mart. 14.206.2
passages.text: Ceston de Veneris sinu calentem.

passages.label: Mart. 14.207.1
passages.text: Sume Cytheriaco medicatum nectare ceston:

passages.label: Mart. 14.207.2
passages.text: Ussit amatorem balteus iste Iovem.

passages.label: Mart. 14.208.1
passages.text: Currant verba licet, manus est velocior illis:

passages.label: Mart. 14.208.2
passages.text: Nondum lingua suum, dextra peregit opus.

passages.label: Mart. 14.209.1
passages.text: Levis ab aequorea cortex Mareotica concha

passages.label: Mart. 14.209.2
passages.text: Fiat: inoffensa curret harundo via.

passages.label: Mart. 14.210.1
passages.text: Non mendax stupor est, nec fingitur arte dolosa.

passages.label: Mart. 14.210.2
passages.text: Quisquis plus iusto non sapit, ille sapit.

passages.label: Mart. 14.211.1
passages.text: Mollia Phrixei secuisti colla mariti.

passages.label: Mart. 14.211.2
passages.text: Hoc meruit tunicam qui tibi, saeve, dedit?

passages.label: Mart. 14.212.1
passages.text: Si solum spectes hominis caput, Hectora credas:

passages.label: Mart. 14.212.2
passages.text: Si stantem videas, Astyanacta putes.

passages.label: Mart. 14.213.1
passages.text: Haec, quae saepe solet vinci, quae vincere raro,

passages.label: Mart. 14.213.2
passages.text: Parma tibi, scutum pumilionis erit.

passages.label: Mart. 14.214.1
passages.text: Non erit in turba quisquam Μισούμενοσ ista:

passages.label: Mart. 14.214.2
passages.text: Sed poterit quivis esse Δὶσ ἐξαπατῶν.

passages.label: Mart. 14.215.1
passages.text: Dic mihi simpliciter, comoedis et citharoedis,

passages.label: Mart. 14.215.2
passages.text: Fibula, quid praestas? 'Carius ut futuant.'

passages.label: Mart. 14.216.1
passages.text: Non tantum calamis, sed cantu fallitur ales,

passages.label: Mart. 14.216.2
passages.text: Callida dum tacita crescit harundo manu.

passages.label: Mart. 14.217.1
passages.text: Praedo fuit volucrum: famulus nunc aucupis idem

passages.label: Mart. 14.217.2
passages.text: Decipit et captas non sibi maeret aves.

passages.label: Mart. 14.218.1
passages.text: Dic quotus et quanti cupias cenare, nec unum

passages.label: Mart. 14.218.2
passages.text: Addideris verbum: cena parata tibi est.

passages.label: Mart. 14.219.1
passages.text: Pauper causidicus nullos referentia nummos

passages.label: Mart. 14.219.2
passages.text: Carmina cum scribas, accipe cor, quod habes.

passages.label: Mart. 14.220.1
passages.text: Non satis est ars sola coco: servire palatum

passages.label: Mart. 14.220.2
passages.text: Nolo: cocus domini debet habere gulam.

passages.label: Mart. 14.221.1
passages.text: Rara tibi curva craticula sudet ofella;

passages.label: Mart. 14.221.2
passages.text: Spumeus in longa cuspide fumet aper.

passages.label: Mart. 14.222.1
passages.text: Mille tibi dulces operum manus ista figuras

passages.label: Mart. 14.222.2
passages.text: Extruet: huic uni parca laborat apis.

passages.label: Mart. 14.223.1
passages.text: Surgite: iam vendit pueris ientacula pistor

passages.label: Mart. 14.223.2
passages.text: Cristataeque sonant undique lucis aves.
